_help.hexFill: Colour of an empty garden hex.
_help.moveGlow: Highlight on hexes a glyphling can move to.
_help.castGlow: Highlight on hexes a seed can be cast to.
_help.glowStrength: How strong the highlights are. 0 = invisible, 1 = solid.
_help.pieceScale: Size of seeds and glyphlings inside their hex. 1 = fills the hex.
_help.ghostOpacity: How visible the faded glyphling left where it started (tap it to send the glyphling back).
_help.yellow: Yellow player's colour — used for their 'held' and 'planned' rings and their thrown seed.
_help.blue: Blue player's colour — same uses as yellow.
_help.plannedSeedOpacity: How faded a targeted (not yet thrown) seed looks. 1 = solid.
